facts.fact: 午夜过后，首席安全官 Shailene 打电话给老板 Fisch 说：「办妥了。男友已经被清除。」Fisch 回答说希望一夜之内完成穿越（crossing）。
facts.anchor: “It’s done,” Shailene told her boss tonight. “The boyfriend has been removed.”

facts.fact: Anthony Fischer 十二岁那年，父亲带他和兄弟去打猎，告诉他 Fischer 家不同于其他家庭；这个秘密不与家族的女性分享，他的母亲对父亲那天透露的事一无所知。
facts.anchor: When Anthony Fischer was twelve years old, his dad took him and his brother on a hunting trip and told him that their family wasn’t like other families. This wasn’t a secret to be shared with the women of the Fischer clan.

facts.fact: 直到那次打猎行 Fisch 才得知：祖父 Elliot 战后曾获美国政府扶持，他建立的整个电子帝国（其设计出消费市场上最受欢迎的电视机）在多方面只是他以国家安全名义在幕后所做专门工作的门面。
facts.anchor: Elliot had received a leg up from the United States government, and that his entire empire was, in many ways, a front for the more specialized work he still did behind the curtains in the name of national security.

facts.fact: Fisch 的父亲 Marty 是终身酒徒，五十四岁（fifty-four）死于肝衰竭；祖父在亲生儿子的葬礼上致悼词，此时他右眼上戴着眼罩。
facts.anchor: Marty died of liver failure at fifty-four. Fisch’s grandpa gave the eulogy at his own son’s funeral, glaring from beneath the eyepatch he wore now over his right iris.

facts.fact: 九十六岁（ninety-six）临终的祖父 Elliot 派人买机票把 Fisch 召回病床前，翻转床边桌上的廉价塑料沙漏做演示；六十秒（sixty seconds）沙粒流尽后，Fisch 无法再否认这是他的 birthright 与家族传承。
facts.anchor: Sixty seconds passed, just as Elliot promised. The last bit of sand dripped down through the plastic pinhole in the center of the hourglass, Elliot secured his eyepatch back into place, and then there was no denying it anymore. Fisch’s birthright.

facts.fact: Fisch 团队的 A/B test 机制：按人口统计信息与观看历史锁定潜在「crooked」受试者，向他们推送 GlobalVill 园区所在城市的初级岗位招聘，把上钩的申请者雇为内容审核员（content moderators），再用定制算法连番推送最可能使其感染 Screen Sickness 的素材来诱发症状。
facts.anchor: How they’d hired the applicants who took the bait as content moderators, then triggered their symptoms via a custom algorithm designed to deploy video after video of exactly the sort of material most likely to infect them with Screen Sickness.

facts.fact: 算法推送的视频虽加速了 Bethany 的症状，但她没有穿越：她差点辞职、开始利用业余时间自行调查 Public Access Afterworld，甚至主动联系了算法给她推送视频的用户之一。
facts.anchor: had not only nearly quit her job, but had begun investigating Public Access Afterworld on her own time, had even taken it upon herself to make contact with one of the users whose videos the algorithm had been serving her.

facts.fact: 为了赶在今天董事会前把 Bethany 推过边缘，Fisch 破例给一名平民（即前夜被清除的男友）下毒，此事令他恶心。
facts.anchor: It had made Fisch sick to poison a civilian, but he’d made an exception in hopes it might nudge Bethany over the edge in time for today’s board meeting.
